title: Miguelito Valdes and Chano Pozo
summary: Machito knew Miguelito Valdes and his family from childhood and says Chano Pozo came later and was younger.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Okay. Had you heard from Mr. Babalu yet?
Yeah. No, but I mean was he already into music at that time? Was he popular?
Oh, definetely. He was with the Havanero Juvenil when he was twelve or fourteen years.
I see. I see. You had heard of Miguelito Valdes.
Oh yes, I know his mother, his grandmother and everyone.
Okay, because you knew Chano Pozo, because Pozo was........
Yes, but Chano Pozo came after.
Now he could be fifty-eight years, I was older than him. When I was twenty he was ah ......
He would've been sixty-three now, sixty-four.
Sixty-four, but the difference when you are twenty and somebody is fifteen, he is a baby and was a man already.
